recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future FamilyMemberHistory work should follow later targeted Jira issues rather than reopening the DSTU1 restructuring.
issue_request: FHIR-5825 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to make FamilyHistory cover a single person's family history, rename it to FamilyMemberHistory, collapse relation-level content to the resource level, and use List for collections of family-member histories.
initial_application: The issue was applied by db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657, a 2015-03-28 commit tagged {#5825} that turned FamilyHistory into List of FamilyMemberHistory, removed old source/familyhistory examples with repeated relation entries, added source/familymemberhistory source, updated profiles, and adjusted List examples.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists familymemberhistory=FamilyMemberHistory and only retains FamilyHistory as a deleted-resource note. The current StructureDefinition models one related person with relationship, note, and repeated conditions at FamilyMemberHistory scope. The introduction says a complete family history can be represented by combining FamilyMemberHistory instances in a List. Later FHIR-16146 declined replacing FamilyMemberHistory with a Condition profile, supporting the current resource model. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent Published DSTU1 Patient Care issue that added FamilyMemberHistory.status after the resource rename; useful context but a separate negation/status decision.
Later Resolved - No Change issue declined replacing FamilyMemberHistory with a Condition profile, supporting the current separate resource model.
